_comment: A canned refine preview, so the proposal list's layout is measured on every capture run
rather than once by hand. Refine is a live Opus call; the layout worth measuring is the
drawer at 320px holding long card names, not the model's taste in swaps.
The card names are real and deliberately span the range: a short one, one at the length
that wraps a 320px drawer, and a double-faced name with a // in it. The reasons are the
length the prompt asks for — under fifteen words.
Shape matches AiRefineResultDto. rejectedByReason is populated on purpose: the empty
case was the only one ever rendered, and refusals are surfaced rather than hidden.

swaps.why: Blocks, then fetches a land instead of dying for nothing.
A body that returns any card, not just a creature or land.
Fetches a dual rather than a basic, and fixes two colours.

swaps.in: Tovolar, Dire Overlord // Tovolar, the Midnight Scourge
swaps.why: Draws on every Wolf connection instead of growing slowly.
The same effect; kept only to show a near-duplicate swap.
